name: Kilnwife Orra
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Kiln Ridge: the Slagborn fire-priestess who fires the high kilns for the warband's rites. P1 'The Firing': a firebrand cone, sparks from the kilns on random players, and three rite lines of fire. P2 at 55% 'The Rite': she draws a ward out of the four kilns while raiders hold the yard — TIP ALL FOUR QUENCH BARRELS (use them) into the kilns to break it — and ash rain burns where it falls. P3, a new health bar 'Orra Unfired': pot shards ride every player, two kiln mouths need two players each, and a firewheel ring. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (four barrels under raiders, two soaks of 2). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and raiders by players enrolled; soak need = clamp(players/5, 2, 4).

pull: The kilns are hot. Bring the offering.
Kilnwife Orra turns from the fire with clay up to her elbows and murder in her eyes.
You will do for the next firing.
say.death: Kilnwife Orra falls against her kiln. 'The fire... was not finished...'
say.reset: Kilnwife Orra goes back to her kilns, singing.

enrage.say: Orra throws every kiln door open at once!

soft.say: The kilns roar louder. The ridge is an oven.

sparks.name: Kiln Sparks
sparks.say: Sparks fly from the kiln mouths!

rite_lines.name: Rite of Three Fires
rite_lines.say: Orra draws three lines of fire through the yard!

ash_rain.name: Ash Rain
ash_rain.say: Hot ash rains from the kiln chimneys!

pot_shards.name: Pot Shards
pot_shards.say: Fired pots burst over everyone — spread out!

kiln_mouths.name: Kiln Mouths
kiln_mouths.say: Two kiln mouths open in the ground — two of you on EACH to hold them shut!

telegraphs.failSay: A kiln mouth is left open — fire sweeps the whole yard!
A kiln mouth is left open — fire sweeps the whole yard!

firewheel.name: Firewheel
firewheel.say: A wheel of fire rolls out from her — get in close!

phases.name: The Rite
phases.say: Kilns, give me your fire! Raiders, hold the yard!

ward.say: Orra draws a ward out of the four kilns. Tip all four quench barrels to break it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: Orra draws a ward out of the four kilns. Tip all four quench barrels to break it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

phases.name: Orra Unfired
phases.say: You QUENCHED my kilns? Then I will fire you by hand!

do.say: Four barrels of water hit four kilns. Steam everywhere — and the ward round Orra cracks!
